title: Gross and net performance with a turnover cost model
source:
"""Daily turnover, gross return, cost and net return for a weight path.

turnover_t = sum_i |w_{i,t} - w_{i,t-1}|, with w_{t-1} = 0 on the first date
gross_t    = sum_i w_{i,t} * r_{i,t}           (weights held that day)
cost_t     = turnover_t * bps / 10_000
net_t      = gross_t - cost_t
Weights and returns are aligned on date and on asset NAME, never on position.
"""
import json
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = "/input/environment/data"
OUT = "/app/output/net_performance.parquet"


def main() -> None:
    w = pd.read_parquet(f"{DATA}/target_weights.parquet")
    r = pd.read_parquet(f"{DATA}/asset_returns.parquet")
    with open(f"{DATA}/cost_model.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        rate = float(json.load(fh)["cost_per_unit_turnover_bps"]) / 10_000.0

    assets = [c for c in w.columns if c != "date"]
    assert set(assets) == {c for c in r.columns if c != "date"}, "same assets in both files"
    w = w.sort_values("date").reset_index(drop=True)
    r = r.set_index("date").loc[w["date"], assets].reset_index()    # align by date and name

    W = w[assets].to_numpy(float)
    R = r[assets].to_numpy(float)
    prev = np.vstack([np.zeros((1, len(assets))), W[:-1]])
    turnover = np.abs(W - prev).sum(axis=1)
    gross = (W * R).sum(axis=1)
    cost = turnover * rate
    net = gross - cost

    out = pd.DataFrame({"date": w["date"], "turnover": turnover, "gross_return": gross,
                        "cost": cost, "net_return": net})
    assert np.allclose(turnover[0], W[0].sum()), "first-day turnover is the day's own weights"
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    out.to_parquet(OUT, index=False)
    back = pd.read_parquet(OUT)
    assert list(back.columns) == ["date", "turnover", "gross_return", "cost", "net_return"]
    print(out.head(3))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
